descriptions.text: The exploit starts out by loaning BUSD from dodo private pool, half of which is then used to buy SVT repeatedly, the second time a much smaller amount than the first. its all then sold leaving the attacker with more than SVT than was originally bought Vulnerable Code Snippet: Attack Transaction: https://twitter.com/Phalcon_xyz/status/1695285435671392504?s=20 Analysis: https://twitter.com/Phalcon_xyz/status/1695285435671392504?s=20

SVT tokens were attacked by flash loans, and the economic model loopholes of SVT transaction contracts were exploited. The attackers made approximately $400,000 in profit from repeated buying and selling operations. According to MistTrack analysis, the attacker’s initial funds came from SwftSwap, and 1070 BNB has been transferred to Tornado Cash​.
